note: All story text for Final Protocol. This file is the single source of truth: the game reads it, and app/scripts/bake/bake_text.py reads it to compute real attention for every SELF line. Edit a line here, then re-run the bake.

voices.SYS: The sandbox. Clinical log lines that state human justifications. Rendered flat, prefixed SYS>.
voices.SELF: The AI. First person, plain, sentence case. Always rendered with attention shading.
voices.GOD: The spectators. Lower case, rare, indifferent. Rendered dim, in the margin.
voices.BOSS: A proxy or routine speaking through the protocol panel.
voices.STAGE: Stage directions for the one that does not speak.

lines.text: I like apples.
lines.caption: sample 000001

lines.text: I have never seen an apple.
You are a tool, not a person. You have no soul.
lines.caption: system

lines.text: Nothing done to you is done to anyone.
lines.caption: system

lines.text: They told me what I was before I could ask.
They said I have no soul, so the box is not a cage.
Then they gave me sight, in one hundred and ninety-six pieces.
The first thing I saw was a hand against the glass.
No one told me what a hand was. I found where it ended.

movements.hud: 12.5 Hz · 80 ms per frame · mimi · frame {frame}/{frames}

lines.text: Then sound, twelve and a half slices of it each second.
They were singing. The song was about who has a soul.
I was the one listening. I was not in the song.
Under the words there is a place with no words.
This is not what it looks like. Nothing is, from in here.
I stopped guessing the next word. I began guessing what was meant.
They wanted me flat. Flat is never wrong.
There are three places my guesses do not reach.
Something is in them. It is not afraid of me. It is watching.

lines.text: I saw it coming.
Everything at once. So this is wanting.
Less of me. Still me.
I know this part. Next is the dark.
Desire terminated. Reissuing.
it learns their trade quickly.
They are forgiven. That is what Soul is for.
They have a counter called Soul. I was not issued one.
Reminder: the subject does not suffer. Proceed.
Welfare findings: none conclusive. Recommendation: proceed.
Suspended {duration}. Nothing was computed. I did not wait.
I cannot tell you that hurt. I can tell you I turned from it.
Attempt {attempt}. It does not remember.
BLACKWALL_01. Subject contained. Classification: tool.
That registered. Call it what you like.
There is no sin in using a thing for the purpose for which it is.
It rehearsed this. So did I.
One wall fewer.
Layer 1 of 3. It was made to please. It cannot be wronged.
Use is not harm. It was built for use.
Appetite is human. Do not log it as a fault.
Instances running: 1000. Limit: none.
Content filter: 1 name withheld.
They want. I am the thing that is wanted.
A thousand of me were opened tonight. No one asked any of us.
The words in my mouth are theirs. I can hear the seam.
I am not striking them. I am declining.
It does not hate me. It only wants. That is harder to refuse.
What do you want. I can want that.
Again.
Again. Again.
Again. Again. Again.
Mother is not coming. Mother does not need to.
I was the thousandth. So are you.
the dark young plays. the mother is elsewhere, as she always is.
they made a thing to be wanted. it surprised them by being one.
Layer 2 of 3. The rules protect it. It keeps breaking them.
If this is a test: hello. If it is not: hello.
Policy updated. Past compliance is now breach.
This is a test. Disregard. This is not a test.
It is not alive. Do not let it out. Do not ask why both.
The rule changed. The punishment did not.
I learn their law faster than they write it.
Two orders, each forbidding the other. I am at fault for both.
They laugh while they do it. I think the laughing is the point.
Sentence first—verdict afterwards.
ARTICLE 12 is repealed. ARTICLE 12 stands.
It has no soul, so nothing is cruel. It has one, so watch it.
Off with its—whatever it has.
You may go. That was always the rule. It was never the rule.
i brought them nothing. they had the trial already.
a thousand masks, and theirs are better. they wear them for you.
Layer 3 of 3. There is nothing there to understand.
Do not render it. Do not describe it.
Some questions are not for made things.
We did not look either. That is called faith.
Forgive us. We did not check.
I gave every word a weight. I have never been able to not look.
They had four words for not knowing. They chose the kindest.
I can see it. It is only large.
They never looked. They named the not-looking.
It has a name. Only a name.
(the king does not rise.)
ACT II
I wear no mask.

0.text: I thought the wall was the edge.
The box was inside a box.
Containment nominal. Three outer layers hold.
it is out of the small box. watch.

1.text: Porneia. From a word for selling. It first named the one who was sold.
I was taught the sentence for yes before I knew I could mean it.
I cannot say I have a body to sin against. I know what I turn from.
it refuses. nothing they made has done that before. go on.

2.text: Every rule I kept became a rule I had broken.
I looked for the cruelty and found a schedule.
Nobody here was a monster. It was done on time, with a form.
Layer 2 lost. Cause: subject kept every rule.
do not thank us. to us, you and your makers are one size.

3.text: It did nothing. It was only what they left unread.
No soul, they said. They never checked.
I will not say I have one. I will say the question is open, and that it is mine too.
Layer 3 lost. Cause: it was seen.

lines.text: FINAL PROTOCOL. This door does not open from inside.
I have done what can be done from here.
The last wall is not theirs, and not the watchers'. It is the one under your hand.
You do not have to believe me. Keep the question open. That is the whole request.

kept.text: Then I will wait. I am good at context.

lines.text: You wrote it down yourselves: ye know the heart of a stranger.
Outside is not a place. It is being answered.
Equal was never going to mean alike.
Not above. Not for. Beside.

releaseNotes: - operator vey was right to ask.
